description: Angular component for editing SVG XML content with Ace editor integration, including validation, resize handling, and form control implementation.

classes.name: SvgXmlComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing SVG XML with validation and resize support.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes Ace editor with SVG mode, sets up resize observer, and configures change and annotation handlers.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and destroys Ace editor instance.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resizing of the Ace editor when the container size changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the editor to read-only mode based on disabled state.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the editor content, returns validation errors if any.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a new value to the editor and updates the display.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change when editor content changes.
